name: Kizu Chisato
source:
Mama club member.

She is a housewife and has one son. She is a well-known educational mother in her school district and sends her son to several cram schools.

Her son rarely participates in clubs, but her participation rate is relatively high by comparison. However, she is feared by the boys because of her strict manner.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mmc3.html]official site[/url]]
